name: Abanca
verdict: A private Galician bank; banker Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez owns 84.75% of it, directly and through his family office. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Private bank (Abanca Corporacion Bancaria, S.A.); Banesco Internacional says its founder Juan Carlos Escotet Rodriguez is also Abanca's principal shareholder, and Abanca's 2025 corporate governance report gives his stake as 84.75% (43.50% direct, 41.25% via Escotet Family Office S.L.U.) with no other shareholder above 5%. No state or fund capital, no serious-abuse record found.
